text: If your security camera ever records tomorrow... do not be home at three A.M.
Do not watch it to the end. Do not wear what you wear in it. Do not go back to check.
This is Instruction four four four.
There are four rules. Follow them exactly. Otherwise, you will have to activate the emergency protocol.
Rule one. Do not watch it to the end.
It starts with a notification. Motion detected. Living room. Three oh two A.M.
You are in bed. The living room should be empty.
You open the app. The clip is grey and quiet. The sofa. The lamp. The front door.
Then you see the date in the corner. It is tomorrow's date.
At the eight second mark, someone walks into the living room. It is you.
You will want to know why you are up at three in the morning. Do not keep watching.
Every second you watch, the bar at the bottom fills in. When it reaches the end, it is not a recording anymore. It is a schedule.
Close the app at the first minute. Do not delete the clip. As long as it has no ending, tomorrow has no ending either.
If you watch it to the end, this is what you would see.
Rule two. Do not wear what you wear in it.
Watch the first minute again. Only the first minute.
The person in the clip is wearing your grey hoodie. The one on your chair right now.
In the dark, the camera cannot see faces. It does not look for faces. It looks for the hoodie.
Throw it away tonight. Take it outside, to the bin on the street.
In the morning, it will be back on your chair. Folded.
Do not put it on. Wear something bright. Something it has never seen you in.
Tomorrow, the person in the clip will still be wearing a grey hoodie. You will not.
Rule three. Do not be home at three A.M.
At two thirty, leave the house. Lock the door from the outside.
Go somewhere bright, with people. Open the live feed on your phone.
At three oh two, the living room is empty. Exactly like the clip. Except you are not in it.
Then the sofa moves. Only a little.
Something long and grey slides out from under it. An arm. Then a joint. Then another joint.
It feels across the floor, where you were supposed to be standing.
It finds nothing. It stops. Its single red eye looks up... at the camera.
Then the feed goes black.
Do not go back to check. Stay where you are until the sun comes up.
Rule four. Emergency protocol. How to fight back.
If you already watched it to the end, the clip is no longer tomorrow. It is tonight.
Here is what does not work.
Do not unplug the camera. The little light will turn red. It keeps recording.
Do not hide in your bedroom. There is a second clip. Bedroom. Three oh four.
Do not call anyone to come over. In the clip, they are the one on the floor.
There is only one thing that works.
It does not know your face. It only knows the grey hoodie.
Roll up the rug and stand it where you stood in the clip. Put the hoodie on it.
Switch off the lights. Wear something bright. Wait behind the sofa with a kitchen knife.
At three oh two, the arm slides out. Its fingers close around the rug.
When it pulls, strike. Bring the knife down on the joint closest to the sofa.
It lets go. The arm slips back into the dark, one joint shorter.
In the morning, there is a new notification. Motion detected. Living room.
You open it. The date is tomorrow again.
The living room is empty. On the floor, by the sofa, there is a long grey finger.
Then, very slowly, something under the sofa turns its head... and looks into the lens. At you, watching.
And that was Instruction four four four.
If this ever happens to you... you know the protocol.
